global_clip_semantics: all autograd gradients participate in the single whole-model global L2 clip; M2 extra-row gradients are retained through clipping even though those rows are excluded from optimizer updates
sealed_firewall: raw sealed rows are not persisted or passed to training/qualification/calibration workers; an experiment-specific SHA-256 commitment is fixed before science and raw sealed rows are regenerated only after DEVELOPMENT_COMPLETE and SEALED_MARKER=STARTED
primary_metric: identity-family candidate-free formation AUC using exact content plus valid EOS stop
sealed_endpoint: identity-family exact content plus valid EOS stop
claim_ceiling: development-scale mechanism evidence only; no production-vocabulary or large-scale authorization
